title: Everything Is Weirdly Cheap in Korea
description:
Shopping in Seoul is cheaper than the US and UK and there are five reasons why. I spent a week in South Korea price-checking Nike, Adidas, designer and Korean brands to find out how much you really save shopping in Korea.

From the weak won to the 10% VAT refund tourists get at the till, Korea has quietly become one of the best value shopping destinations in the world. 

🇰🇷 Shopping in Korea — what you need to know:
Tax refund: spend ₩15,000+, show your passport, tax comes off at the till
Bring your passport everywhere
Scan receipts at the airport before you fly or the refund gets reversed

About:

This video takes you on a tour through the vibrant streets of Seoul to visit popular retail locations. We focus on the reality of shopping in Seoul, comparing the atmosphere of massive shoe stores like the Jordan flight store against local Korean fashion boutiques. If you are planning a trip to South Korea or just love retail culture, this breakdown provides a clear look at where to find unique items and what kind of budget you might need.

We break down the diverse retail environments found across the city, from high-end areas to accessible street-level shops. By the end of this tour, you will have a better understanding of what to expect when navigating Korean fashion brands and the local shoe scene. Whether you are hunting for limited releases or simply browsing local trends, this guide helps you map out your next shopping in Seoul itinerary.
